title: Scatter plot
description:
A scatter plot puts one point per row at (`x_column`, `y_column`); `color_column`
splits the points into colored groups (`colors` by name). See `:help dbdash-chart-types`.

query.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < 40),
d AS (SELECT 10 + (i * 37) % 90 AS ad_spend, i % 3 AS k FROM n)
SELECT ad_spend, ad_spend * 2 + abs(random() % 60) AS sales,
       CASE k WHEN 0 THEN 'High' WHEN 1 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS margin
FROM d

show.title: color_column, colors, x_label / y_label (canvas: braille)
show.description:
`color_column` makes one group per value, colored by `colors` (a mapping by name, or a
list by position); `x_label` / `y_label` title the axes.

FROM d

show.title: style: point, trend_line: linear
show.description:
`point` draws each point as a character (Chart.js `pointStyle`); `trend_line: linear`
adds a dashed least-squares line per group (ECharts regression).

query.sql:

show.title: axes: grid, ticks; mark_lines
show.description:
`axes.*.grid` draws grid lines at the ticks, `ticks` asks for about that many ticks;
`mark_lines` adds reference lines: the mean sales, and x = 50.

query.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < 30)
SELECT power(10, (abs(random() % 400) / 100.0)) AS size_kb,
       power(10, (abs(random() % 300) / 100.0)) AS ms
FROM n

show.title: axes: scale: log on both axes
show.description:

one tick per power of ten.
